sectors.D: Electricity, gas, steam and air conditioning

errors.currency: Use a 3-letter currency code, e.g. AMD.

frozen.locked: This period is locked. Data, mapping and calculations are read-only; an admin can reopen it with a reason on Review & audit.
frozen.review: This period is in review. Data and calculations are read-only until it is approved or sent back to Open.

illustrative.title: Illustrative factors — not for disclosure
illustrative.body: These results were calculated with “{set}”, a factor set flagged as illustrative. The numbers show how the method works; replace the factors with a sourced set before reporting.

picker.empty: No portfolio or reporting period yet.

kpi.undrawn: Undrawn commitments would add {v} tCO2e (shown separately, not in the totals).

overview.title: Financed emissions
overview.subtitle: PCAF Part A climate profile of the loan book for the selected period.
overview.helpBody: Figures come from the latest calculation run of the period. Filters recalculate the tiles for a branch, segment or asset class. Click a contributor to see how its number was built: inputs, factor, attribution and result.
overview.noRun: No calculation has been run for this period yet. Upload a loan tape, then run a calculation.
overview.dqDistSub: Share of calculated outstanding by PCAF score

lineage.title: Line {ref}
lineage.noLibraryFactor: No library factor was needed (reported data or the building-energy grid default; see the explanation).

portfolios.title: Portfolios & periods
portfolios.subtitle: Set up loan books and their reporting periods.
portfolios.helpBody: Each reporting period holds one loan tape and its calculation runs. A period moves from Open to In review to Locked; locked periods are read-only and keep their numbers reproducible.
portfolios.empty: No portfolio yet. Create one to start.
portfolios.needClass: Choose at least one asset class.
portfolios.currencyHint: Amounts on the tape must be in this currency (no FX conversion in this version).
portfolios.inflationHint: Recorded for later; values are not adjusted in this version.
portfolios.ledgerHint: Total outstanding per the general ledger; used to reconcile the loan tape.
portfolios.confirmDelete: Delete portfolio “{name}” with all its open periods?

intake.title: Data intake
intake.subtitle: Upload loan tapes per asset class, fix errors and reconcile to the ledger.
intake.helpBody: Download the template for the asset class, fill one row per facility and upload it as CSV or XLSX. Client ids are pseudonymised on upload (only a hash is stored); names are optional. Uploading a facility ref again updates that line.
intake.templateHint: Required columns: facilityRef, outstanding, currency; counterpartyId for business loans and project finance; valueAtOrigination for real estate and vehicles.
intake.policy: Valid rows are saved and rows with errors are rejected; download the error list, fix the rows and upload them again.

counterparties.title: Counterparties
counterparties.subtitle: Pseudonymised registry with sector codes, financials and reported emissions.
counterparties.helpBody: Add revenue to move a line from score 5 to 4; add production, energy-based or reported emissions to reach 3, 2 or 1 (verified). Total equity + debt is needed to attribute business loans.
counterparties.search: Search id prefix, name or NACE
counterparties.empty: No counterparties yet — they are created from loan tapes.
counterparties.saved: Saved. Run a new calculation to update results.
counterparties.frozen: This counterparty only appears in periods that are in review or locked, so it is read-only.
counterparties.nameHint: Optional; never exported unless an admin asks.
counterparties.emissionsHint: Scope 1 and 2 in tCO2e for the counterparty as a whole. The calculation uses the best record up to the reporting year.

calc.title: Calculations
calc.subtitle: Run the PCAF engine, check reproducibility and work through exceptions.
calc.helpBody: Each run stores the methodology version, factor set and a hash of every input and output. Verify re-computes a run from today's data: matching hashes prove the numbers can be reproduced.
calc.noSets: No factor set yet — add one on Factors & mapping.
calc.illustrativeChosen: This factor set is illustrative; results will carry a warning.
calc.methodNote: Financed emissions = attribution × counterparty or property emissions (Scope 1+2). Missing inputs become exceptions; nothing is defaulted.
calc.outputsDiffer: Same inputs, different outputs — contact support
calc.noExceptions: No exceptions — every line has a result.

review.title: Review & audit
review.subtitle: Sign-off workflow, comments and the audit trail of the period.
review.helpBody: Anyone can submit a calculated period for review. An admin approves (locks) or sends it back with a comment. Reopening a locked period needs a reason, and every step is logged.
review.latestRun: Latest run {date}: {t} tCO2e, coverage {cov}%, weighted score {dq}, {ex} exceptions.
review.adminOnly: Approve, reject and reopen need the Admin role (finer FE roles come later).
review.reasonPlaceholder: Why must this locked period change?
review.reasonRequired: A reason is required to reopen a locked period.

reports.title: Reports & disclosures
reports.subtitle: PCAF disclosure tables and the IFRS S2 Category 15 view.
reports.helpBody: The workbook has four sheets: PCAF disclosure per asset class, financed emissions by sector with gross exposure and % covered, line-level results and methodology notes with hashes.
reports.noRun: No calculation run for this period yet.
reports.draft: This period is not locked yet — treat exports as drafts.
reports.masked: Exports show pseudonymised ids only, unless an admin includes names.

factors.title: Factors & mapping
factors.subtitle: Versioned factor sets and sector-code mapping.
factors.helpBody: Upload factors as CSV (kind,key,region,currency,unit,value,scope1Share,notes). Kinds: revenue_sector and asset_sector (tCO2e per million), building_benchmark and energy_label (kWh/m²/yr), grid (kgCO2e/kWh). Once a run uses a set it is frozen; create a new version to change it.
factors.name: Name
factors.sourceHint: Publisher, table and year, so reviewers can trace every value.
factors.inUse: Used by {n} run(s): frozen for reproducibility.
factors.mappingHint: Lookup order: exact NACE code → division → section → your mapping for local codes.
factors.queueEmpty: Every counterparty sector in this period can be matched.
factors.blankHint: Add a NACE code on the counterparty
factors.mapSaved: {n} mapping(s) saved. Run a new calculation to apply them.
